answer: How Work and Jobs have changed. The way people work today has greatly changed from the past as a result of technological inventions. Long time ago, most job plannings were focussed on fixed working hours and communication passed through memos and usually physical meetigs. The information and records were stored in files that filled the wall cabinets. Today, technology has done key tranformationns at the work place, with communications passed via emails, workers performing tasks virtually andmeetigs extensivelly organised through zoom and other video conferencing apps. Technology has also created new jobs like app development and many have got it very engaging than the traditional job styles that involved meeting at the office. These changes have brough flexible working schedules, helping parents and students at higher levels to balance studies and other social life aspects. This has been witnessed by Benard at BIP who is able to study and workk at the same time. technology also comes with several challenges such as the need for a constant internet connection which is also paid for leaving the poor behind. Automation has brought a great threat threat to the traditional workers who feel at risk of losing their jons. Conclusively, technology has made work more flexible through enhancing connectivity at all times. The key aspect is only adapting to the changes that it has brought for us.
